name: Carbon & Energy Efficiency
enginesVendoredAt: NextGen, sha-identical with engines f0aef14 through the lead's shared vendor commit fe001b52 (feat/et-vendor-downstream). The carbon files are unchanged since 5c0cb97 (engines PR #226, MD5-0), which is what Suite origin/main vendors.

gwp.source: GHG Protocol, IPCC Global Warming Potential Values v2.0 (7 August 2024), from IPCC AR6 WG1 ch.7 7.6.1.1 and AR5 WG1 ch.8
gwp.courseSet: IPCC AR6 GWP100, fossil methane: CH4 29.8, N2O 273
gwp.held: H1: which report to file on is the owner's decision; taught as a stated limit, never graded

plan.state: FOUNDATION: recon, structure, digest, eighteen graded fields, scaffold and task files. No lesson, bank, panel or migration.
plan.thesis: A tonne of CO2e is carbon counted atom by atom, weighted by a declared GWP set and carried on a record that says where every factor came from, and a tonne saved is priced over the life of the measure that saves it; the engines refuse or name every box nobody filled (a destruction efficiency, a factor, a safe oxygen floor, a discount rate) instead of reading it as the best case.

tiers.beginner: THE INVENTORY: the atom balance, the flare and its destruction efficiency, escaped carbon as methane, GWP sets and their reports, factors as records, computed against reportable, intensity and its boundary. Graded: six tonnes at 0.01.
tiers.intermediate: THE HEATER, THE STEAM AND THE PINCH: combustion from the fuel analysis, excess air, stack loss on LHV and HHV, the tuning saving as a ratio, the failed trap, condensate, the problem table. Graded: two percents at 0.0001, a fuel saving at 1 GJ, a steam loss at 0.01 t, two utilities at 0.01 kW.
tiers.advanced: THE CURVE AND THE PATH: the levelised cost of a tonne, the curve and its weighted average, interactions and over-claims, the target and the path, a saving priced in money and carbon, energy intensity. Graded: four USD per tonne and one USD at 0.01, one gap in tCO2e at 0.01.

digest.note: No section is history. SECTION 25 states the held items and the MD5-0 rules in force in the present tense, each with the section that prints it. No clock is read. Lines marked 'computed here' are the generator's arithmetic on engine figures (differences, shares, the percentage-point shortcut, capital against one year).

grading.grader: public.academy_submit_capstone reads expected, tol and the answer as numeric, so every graded field is a number the engine returns; verdicts and refusals are taught and never graded.
grading.tolerance: One unit in the last place the prompt asks for. The tuning saving is asked to the whole GJ (tol 1): it is a ratio of two efficiencies the engine rounds to six decimals, and a learner reading them to four lands up to about half a GJ away. One derivation: CLASSES in carbon_capstone.mjs; precision.json is written from it.
grading.collisionRule: No graded value within its tolerance of the absolute value of any number token the digest prints (the go-live rule), and no two graded values within the looser of their tolerances.

findings.F1: STOPPED FOR THE LEAD: abatementCurve returns meetsTarget true, 'upper bound: measures interact', when a claim acts on a source absent from sourceEmissions. The MD5-0 Suite page (C11) leaves an uncomputed source out, so at the Carbon Studio's opening defaults (flare efficiency blank) the 9000 t flare recovery claim goes unchecked and the page shows 'met, as an upper bound'. Reproduction recon_pagedefaults.mjs. Taught as printed (SECTION 21 row 3), never graded. Lead: engine repair (unchecked source makes meetsTarget null) or hold.
findings.F2: stackLossEfficiency computes any basis other than exactly 'HHV' on LHV and labels it with the caller's string ('hhv' returns the LHV 89.821412 labelled hhv). Not live (the pages pass constants). Repair: refuse an unknown basis.
findings.F3: abatementCurve drops a refused measure without naming it; the Suite path still schedules it. Page lists refused measures. Repair: name them in the curve result.
findings.F4: emissionLine accepts a negative activity or factor; the inventory stays reportable and the intensity goes negative (C4's shape on the inventory side).
findings.F5: condensateReturnValue accepts a target return below the current one: a negative saving, complete true, no note.
findings.F6: steamTrapLoss reports choked true at any pressure (no downstream pressure input); not choked at 1.2 bar a to atmosphere. Course traps at 9 and 8.213 bar a.
findings.F7: decarbonisationPath allows negative emissions; a blank unburned loss is read as 0 unnamed and a negative radiation loss raises efficiency; makeGwpSet accepts a negative GWP.
findings.oracle-coverage: The tuning saving's duty ledger, the trap fuel and carbon, condensate and energy intensity are computed only in oracle_energyefficiency.main(); the tuning saving is graded through a marked transcription (recommend exporting duty_ledger()). carbonIntensity, residualToTargetTonnes, paysForItselfTonnes, compositeCurve and simplePaybackYears have no oracle and are not graded.
findings.suite-page: The MD5-0 Suite PR #543 (fix/md5-0-carbon-apps) merged into Suite origin/main as 60871c1e8 during this recon; the page behaviours the course teaches (blank heater efficiency refused, sources in CO2e, blanks passed as missing, partial-inventory warning, verdict labels, trap exponent, basis select) depend on it and on the Suite upload.
findings.clock: Neither engine reads a clock or a random number: source read, fake clock and fake random rebuilds byte-identical.

decisions: Course code prefix cef (checked unused in migrations/, tools/course-banks/ and waves.json).

Every inventory is computed on IPCC AR6 GWP100 with fossil methane (29.8), following the engine's own methaneNote (C10); AR6 non-fossil, AR5 fossil and AR5 non-fossil are printed beside it; the choice of report to file on is H1 and is never graded.
Every graded field is the engine's full-precision return, graded at one unit in the last place the prompt asks for; the tuning saving to the whole GJ.
The Associate capstone grades the flare's methane line in CO2e on the stated set, which makes the GWP set a numeric discriminator without grading a choice of set.
The Professional trap pressure is given on a gauge with the local atmosphere, so a gauge read as absolute is a discriminate route.
Carbon intensity is taught and not graded: no oracle recomputes it.
Manifests carry the three panel ids, so courseContent.test.js 'every panel referenced is registered' is red until the panel phase registers them.
Nothing is added to academyModules.js; the lab phase adds 'energy_transition' to CourseModuleNav MODULE_ORDER after 'supply_chain' on the same line as gasvalue.
